parsed.rationale: All five participating records are `type-alias-object` kinds with empty `fields_or_signature` lists, meaning the structural signal is purely that they are type aliases with no fields — not that they alias the same underlying type or share meaningful semantic content. `Discogs.Release.Label`, `Discogs.Release.ReleaseArtist`, and `Discogs.Master.ReleaseArtist` live in `Shared/Artwork/Sources/Artwork/DiscogsArtworkService.swift` and model Discogs API response shapes, while `Release` and `Artist` in `Shared/Metadata/Sources/Metadata/_Plant_ReleaseRepository.swift` and `_Plant_ArtistRepository.swift` are repository-layer aliases in the `Metadata` package. The coincidence is purely structural (all happen to be zero-field type aliases); the domain concepts — Discogs wire-format labels/artists vs. repository-layer domain entities — are unrelated. Consolidating them would conflate API-response modeling with domain modeling across two distinct packages.
